premises.text: Users want to create custom plush toys online.
premises.evidence_span: give users the ability to create cool, cute, and crazy custom plush toys online.

premises.text: The market for plush toys is significant.

premises.text: Customers are increasingly accustomed to designing their own products online.

premises.text: The platform allows users to customize various aspects of plush toys.

premises.text: The company can manufacture and deliver the custom toys to users.

premises.text: The pricing of the toys is competitive with existing options like Build-A-Bear.
